Maya Patel: Quick sync — after the DR incident yesterday we need to lock owners and timelines for remediation items: multi-region routing tests, backup integrity job, restore runbook dry-run, and the game-day rehearsal. I started a tracker doc, will paste plan below. @Samir can you take multi-region routing tests? @Lucy can you own backup verification? @André take the restore dry-run?

Samir Khan: Yep — I can own routing. Plan: staging canary on Fri, limited prod simulation next Tue. Need a routing playground and 2 ephemeral IPs. Any objections?

Lucy Chen: I can do backup verification. Proposed steps: checksum compare for last 3 snapshots, incremental restore into warm pod, validate app boot. Can finish by Mon EOD given access to snapshot export.

André Silva: I'll own restore runbook updates and dry-run. Need to add KMS key rotation steps and explicit DB single-writer promotion steps. Dry-run target: Thurs morning. Will update runbook with a checklist.

Maya Patel: Thanks. Adding owners + dates to the tracker now:
- Multi-region routing smoke — owner: Samir Khan — staging canary: Fri Mar 27 — prod sim: Tue Mar 31
- Backup verification — owner: Lucy Chen — health check complete: Mon Mar 23
- Restore runbook dry-run — owner: André Silva — dry-run: Thu Mar 26
- DR rehearsal (game day) — owner: Maya Patel — schedule: Fri Apr 2 (half-day)

Samir Khan: Quick Q — where should we stage routing changes? Is there an existing 'routing-playground' namespace? @infra-bot?

infra-bot: Created namespace routing-playground in staging and opened CIDR allocation ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFRA-4123

Lucy Chen: @Maya — I'll need s3-read access to snapshot-export and a temp role for restore tests. Who grants?

Maya Patel: @André please coordinate with security for the temp role. I'll follow up with a short PR to grant s3-read for the test window.

Ops Runbook Bot: Runbook updated: /runbooks/dr-restore.md (rev 3) — diff: https://git.redwood.com/runbooks/dr-restore/commits/3

André Silva: Uploaded dry-run checklist to the runbook and added the manual DB bring-up steps. Leaving some TODO comments for replication verification scripts.

Maya Patel: Great progress. Action owner recap: Samir (routing), Lucy (backups), André (runbook). I'll schedule a 30m sync next Wed to close blockers. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
